 What if I can’t get a Real ID driver’s license and need to fly within the United States? 
 The Real ID driver’s license is now one of the few forms of identification accepted for official purposes, such as boarding commercial flights, visiting nuclear plants, or entering certain government offices .
 Alert . Official | Driver licenses canceled for everyone who failed to meet requirements or committed violations: full list abre en nueva pestaña That has been the case since May 2025, when the Real ID Act took effect nationwide, barring the TSA from accepting driver’s licenses that do not meet the certification requirements or are not considered acceptable and setting federal standards for issuing identification credentials.
 To apply for one, five different types of documents are required; otherwise, the process cannot go forward.
 Real ID driver’s license applications will be denied for those who cannot present the five required documents
 The Transportation Security Administration (TSA) says applicants should check the specific documents required by each driver licensing agency to make sure they are submitting all required paperwork . Even so, all states will require documents proving the following information:
 Full legal name 
 Date of birth 
 Social Security number 
 Two proof-of-address documents showing your primary residence 
 Legal status 
 What if I can’t get a Real ID driver’s license and need to fly within the United States?
 If that process cannot be completed, there are alternative documents the TSA accepts if they are current or expired by no more than two years:
 Enhanced Driver License (EDL) or Enhanced Identification Card (EID) 
 Digital driver’s licenses (mDLs) with approval for federal use 
 Passport book 
 Passport card 
 DHS Trusted Traveler card 
 U.S. Department of Defense ID 
 Permanent resident card 
 Border crossing card (BCC) 
 Acceptable photo ID issued by a tribal nation or Indigenous community recognized by the U.S. government 
 HSPD-12 PIV card 
 Foreign passport 
 Canadian provincial driver’s license or Canada Indian and Northern Affairs card 
 Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) 
 U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services Employment Authorization Card (I-766) 
 U.S. Merchant Mariner Credential 
 Veteran Health Identification Card (VHIC) 
 Also accepted are:
 Apple Digital ID 
 Clear ID 
 Google ID pass 
 Samsung ID with CLEAR 
 You can also pay $45 for an alternative verification known as TSA ConfirmID.
